blocks.text: Qudrati zaraye mein bijli ki kaundh (lightning), aatish-fishan (volcanoes), hayatiyati galna-sarna, jangal ki aag, mitti ke microorganisms aur samandar shamil hain. NO tab banta hai jab bijli ki kaundh ke doran hawa ke N2 aur O2 react karte hain, aur yeh hawa ki nitrogen istemal karne wale microorganisms se bhi banta hai.

blocks.caption: NOx ke qudrati zaraye
rows: garam discharge mein N2 + O2 se 2NO
zyada darja hararat aur hayatiyati ikhraj

blocks.prompt: Wazeh karein ke aandhi-toofan mitti mein nitrate kaise shamil kar sakta hai.
blocks.explanation: Bijli ki kaundh hawa ko itna garam karti hai ke nitrogen aur oxygen mil kar NO banate hain, jo NO2 mein oxidise hota hai; yeh barish mein nitric aur nitrous acids ke taur par halta hai aur nitrate ke taur par mitti tak pohnchta hai jo paude istemal kar sakte hain.

items: Qudrati NOx: bijli ki kaundh (N2 + O2 se NO), aatish-fishan, galna, jangal ki aag, mitti ke microbes, samandar.
